ModMetaData.name: Coinage - Silver Currency & MO Smelting 1.5
ModMetaData.author: Allen
ModMetaData.description: RimWorld 1.5 patch: Coinage's silver-material coin (Coin_Silver) becomes the actual trade denomination at 10 coins per 1 vanilla silver value. Trade prices remain in vanilla silver-value units. Adds a Medieval Overhaul furnace recipe that remelts any pure Coinage metallic coin back to its source metal at 10 coins -> 1 source unit.
